_README: Rename this file to images.json and the experimental Song Archive picks it up on the next load.
No page edit is needed. The page fetches /glostik-songs/images.json, merges it over its own
defaults, and carries on without it when the file is absent (it answers 404 today, on purpose).
Pictures are assigned BY PURPOSE, never by a path written into the markup. Four purposes, three
shapes, so a supplied collection can be curated rather than repeated:
console   the tall field behind the console head, cut by a hard diagonal.  portrait or any
Only the first entry is drawn. Give it something that survives a
heavy grayscale and a green wash, because that is what it gets.
break     the wide bands that sit between catalog sections, behind the      panoramic, about
oversized era type. Cycled by section position, so no two         21:6 or wider
neighbouring breaks take the same picture. Put the most
photographic material here: this is where the band appears.
era       one picture per named era, keyed by the section label the         wide 16:9
ordering produces. Keys that exist today: a four digit year
("2021" through "2026"), "Past 7 days", "Past 30 days",
"Past 90 days", "Past year", "Not played yet", "Most played",
"Least played", "Longest gaps", "Shortest gaps". An era with no
entry borrows a frame from a stream of that year.
texture   graphic material rather than photography: Twitch emote art,       square
posters, logos, stickers. Used in the break pool after the
supplied photographs run out.
Per entry:
src     the image URL, or a path under /glostik-songs/img/ for a file kept in this repository
alt     what the picture shows, for a screen reader. Required.
credit  a short label: a venue, a date, a photographer
alt2    optional smaller fallback, tried once if src fails to load
Anything that fails to load hides its own box and the composition holds, because no part of the
layout depends on a picture being there. Delete this _README key in the real file.
